page.title: Phone resilience
page.subtitle: See how your phones are being answered right now, set who gets called if the AI assistant is down, and prove your carrier forwards missed calls to Vireek.

noAccess.title: Phone resilience is limited to account managers
noAccess.description: Ask the account owner for business-profile access to change how calls are handled when the AI assistant is unavailable.

status.forcedNote: Your account is set to level {{level}} until {{until}}. Automatic changes are paused for your calls.
status.ladderTitle: How a call is handled at each level

0.name: Full AI assistant
0.desc: The assistant answers, books and looks things up.

1.name: Reduced assistant
1.desc: Still answers every call and takes name, number, address and emergencies, but cannot book or look things up.

2.name: Voicemail and instant alert
2.desc: Callers hear an emergency option and can leave a message. You get the transcript by text.

3.name: Forward to your team
3.desc: Calls ring your on-call phones in order, then fall back to voicemail.

4.name: Recorded message
4.desc: A recorded message with emergency instructions plays.

recentEmpty.title: No backup-handled calls
recentEmpty.description: Calls that skip the AI assistant will appear here with what happened to each one.

outcome.abandoned: Caller hung up, call back needed

settings.title: Backup handling
settings.intro: These apply whenever the AI assistant cannot take a call. Calls are never dropped: they are forwarded, recorded or answered with a message.
settings.forwardHelp: One per line, up to {{max}}. Include the country code, for example +15551234567.
settings.staticHelp: Played only when nothing else can handle the call. Leave empty to use our default. Emergency instructions are always added.
settings.assistantHelp: The ID of a short, no-tools assistant created in your voice provider. Leave empty if you don't have one yet.
settings.alertSms: Text me when call handling changes
settings.alertSmsHelp: One message when the assistant degrades or recovers. In-app notices are always sent.
settings.frontDoor: Route this account's numbers through the backup front door
settings.frontDoorHelp: Turn on only after your support contact has pointed your numbers at it and the test below has passed.

errors.assistantInvalid: Use 8 to 64 letters, numbers, dashes or underscores.

override.title: Pin call handling for a while
override.help: Use this when you know the assistant should not answer, for example during an incident, or to test your backup. It expires automatically.
override.invalid: Choose a level and 1 to 1440 minutes.

wizard.title: Carrier safety net
wizard.intro: Set your own phone line to forward to Vireek when you don't answer or can't be reached. Then prove it works with a real test call.
wizard.familyLabel: Who provides your business phone line?

family.gsm_standard: AT&T, T-Mobile or another mobile carrier
family.landline_voip_pbx: Landline, VoIP or office phone system

noNumbers.title: No Vireek number yet
noNumbers.description: Add a phone number to your account first, then come back to set up forwarding.

wizard.businessHelp: We call this number for the test. It must be the phone number saved on your account.
wizard.planTitle: Dial these on your business phone

kind.unreachable: Forward when your phone is off or out of coverage
kind.busy: Forward when the line is busy

wizard.noCode: No universal code exists for this. Set “forward when no answer” in your provider's account or phone-system settings, then run the test.
wizard.testOnHelp: We'll call your business line. Let it ring and do not answer. If forwarding works, the call arrives at Vireek.
wizard.testOffHelp: After turning forwarding off, we'll call again. It should ring out on your phone and must not reach Vireek.
wizard.tip: Turn off your carrier's own voicemail for this line, or it may answer before the forward happens.

pendingOn.title: Test call in progress
pendingOn.body: Let your phone ring. Do not answer.

pendingOff.title: Test call in progress
pendingOff.body: Let your phone ring out. It should not reach Vireek.

passedOn.title: Forwarding works
passedOn.body: The test call reached Vireek from your business line. Missed calls will be caught.

passedOff.title: Forwarding is off
passedOff.body: The test call rang out on your phone and did not reach Vireek.

failedOn.title: The call did not reach Vireek
failedOn.body: Check the dial code, that forwarding applies to your plan, and that carrier voicemail is off. Then try again.

failedOff.title: The call still reached Vireek
failedOff.body: Forwarding appears to still be on. Dial the turn-off code and try again.

answered.title: Your phone was answered
answered.body: A forward can only happen if nobody picks up. Run the test again and let it ring.

expired.title: We couldn't confirm the result
expired.body: The test call didn't finish as expected. Try again.

error.title: The test call failed
error.body: We couldn't place the call. Try again in a minute.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many test calls this hour. Try again later.
errors.forbidden: That number isn't on your account.
errors.notConfigured: Test calls aren't switched on for your account yet. Contact support.
